values: Douglas County Election Commission
November 5, 2024 Statewide Presidential General Election
Official Results
To view the results of a particular race, click on the tab for the sheet you wish to view.
The tabs are located at the bottom of the screen.  Use the Left & Right arrows to navigate
through the tabs (arrows are located in the bottom-left side of the screen).
The votes for a precinct reflect ballots cast via early voting and at polling places.
The columns on each sheet will show:
Ward-Precinct: Ward 1, Precinct 1 is listed as 01-01
Total Votes: Is the total votes cast for that race
Candidate Name: Lists the votes cast for each candidate
% of Vote: Lists the percentage of votes received for the candidate
Over Votes: Occurs when a voter tries to vote for more candidates than allowed
Under Votes: Occurs when a voter does not vote in a race or does not vote for all the candidates allowed
